note: Derived reading aid. Never authoritative; never read as intent (Decision 0004). The Plan document governs.
author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Queue approved work or run it in an independent session
purpose: Approved work should either wait in an order or start as a separate session when capacity is free, without disturbing work already in progress. The first step is to prove that one scout request can reach a reviewed, passing pull request while production stays off.
serves: The Project outcome of Arcadia driving coding agents and reporting back, with the operator deciding only where needed.
done_when: An approved request is queued or started as an independent session, and a scout run for Hello World reaches a reviewed, passing pull request with production turned off.
reading_note: Draft: all 7 Actions are still open. The first Action is an isolation check that comes before any new model call.

actions.title: Check the scout's isolation before any new model call
actions.why: The last trial stopped on an unexplained config change, so isolation must be checked before another live run.
actions.done_when: A replay of the retained failed trial runs with no model call, and a preflight record pins the source, runtime, model and before-state.

actions.title: Carry an approved request into an executable packet
actions.why: The builder declined an approved packet, and extra tests were added to a request limited to one file.
actions.done_when: A request for one exact file stays limited to that file, and the approval packet carries its approval receipt without repeating the approval gate.

actions.title: Show the scout run and its result in Ask and To-do
actions.why: Approval reported no run and said the request was resuming, so the operator could not see what happened.
actions.done_when: Ask and To-do show the same run state, waiting reason and evidence, and a queued approval never counts as a completed Hello World.

actions.title: Prove one bounded scout run ends in a green pull request
actions.why: Shows the smallest complete path works while managed production stays off, before building automatic side sessions.
actions.done_when: One explicitly authorized scout run delivers Hello World as a pull request that an independent review passes and whose required checks pass.

actions.title: Admit independent sessions within free capacity
actions.why: Lets urgent work start beside current work without disrupting the Plan in progress.
actions.done_when: Approved work queues by default, and an independent session starts only with verified approval, one concrete assignment and free capacity.

actions.title: Show the same disposition in the command line, API and screens
actions.why: Keeps all three surfaces on one data contract, so none carries its own execution logic.
actions.done_when: The command line, API and Ask screen show the same queue position, waiting reason and session evidence, and the supported flow is documented.

actions.title: Run the bounded scout loop with at most two repair cycles
actions.why: Lets the scout retry a failure a limited number of times, so it does not loop without end.
actions.done_when: The scout runs the Hello World loop, collects evidence and deduplicated bugs, runs at most two verified repair cycles, and then stops.
